dataset: NHTSA Standing General Order (ADS) Incident Reports -- Monthly Summary
source: NHTSA Standing General Order 2021-01, ADS incident reports
coverage: National -- all ADS operators reporting under SGO 2021-01
notes: One latest version per NHTSA report ID; earlier versions remain in sgo_incidents_all_versions.csv. Counts are reports, not verified at-fault crashes. Monthly charts use the latest report version's filing month/year when present, not the incident month; reports without a valid filing month remain in all-time counts.
vehicle_class_and_program_type_note: vehicle_class (trucking/light_duty) and program_type (commercial/testing) are the Observatory's OWN editorial classification of each reporting entity's primary business focus, NOT a field NHTSA provides. See pipelines/sgo/operator_classification.py for the mapping and its documented limitations.
